Container.Name: curatorx
Container.Overview: CuratorX was renamed to Projectionist. Prefer the Projectionist CA template (templates/projectionist.xml / search Projectionist). This legacy template remains for Community Applications installs that still cache this TemplateURL. Image digests match romwil/projectionist via dual Hub tags during the compatibility window. Keep port 8788 on a trusted LAN. Existing config path: /mnt/user/appdata/curatorx/config.
Container.Requires: Plex Media Server on your LAN. Optional: Radarr, Sonarr, Tautulli, Fanart.tv, and an LLM API key or Ollama on the Unraid host.
Container.Changes: ### Compatibility notice - Product renamed to **Projectionist**. Install or migrate via `templates/projectionist.xml`. - Hub dual-tags: `romwil/curatorx:*` and `romwil/projectionist:*` share identical digests during the compatibility window. - Full notes: https://github.com/romwil/projectionist/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
Container.Description:
**CuratorX was renamed to Projectionist.** Prefer the [Projectionist Unraid template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/romwil/projectionist/main/templates/projectionist.xml) for new installs and template refreshes.
This legacy template remains so Community Applications can still resolve the old TemplateURL. Repository `romwil/curatorx:latest` is dual-tagged to the same digests as `romwil/projectionist:latest` during the compatibility window.
**Config path:** keep `/mnt/user/appdata/curatorx/config` for existing installs (do not move appdata). New installs may use `/mnt/user/appdata/projectionist/config` with the Projectionist template.
**Security:** LAN-only or authenticated reverse proxy; do not WAN-expose bare `:8788`. Legacy `CURATORX_*` env vars still work (runtime dual-reads `PROJECTIONIST_*`).
**Support:** [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/romwil/projectionist/issues) · [Unraid wiki](https://github.com/romwil/projectionist/blob/main/docs/wiki/Unraid.md)
